name: Felnok Steelspring
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I have another favor to ask of you.

My initial study of the essence you collected shows that it might be possible to freeze dragon whelp eggs and preserve them!  I want to test this theory, but first I need specially made engineering components.  My colleague, Felnok Steelspring, can make them.

Here, take this letter to Felnok.  It tells him what I need.  You'll find Felnok in Winterspring, in the town of Everlook.
narrative.objectives: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.
narrative.offerRewardText:
That's no blanket! But what have we here? I letter from Tinkee? I wonder what she has to say...

Ah, she's studying in the Burning Steppes. That makes sense--that's a good source for dragonkin. Oh, but look! It says here that she needs some parts for a device she wants to build. I guess that's where I come in, eh?
narrative.requestItemsText: It's cold up here! I hope you brought me a blanket!

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 52 to 60, 51,400 XP in all.

quests.name: Broodling Essence
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Felnok Steelspring

quests.name: Chillwind Horns

quests.name: Return to Tinkee
quests.objectiveText: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Egg Freezing
quests.objectiveText: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

quests.name: Egg Collection
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Leonid Barthalomew
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Betina Bigglezink
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
